answer: The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the river of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the vine until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the marble of the next round. Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short.
